name: Roland SonicCell
description: Roland SonicCell sound module with audio interface (2007): the setup and system blocks, the temporary performance (common, MFX 1-3, chorus, reverb, and every part's Part and MIDI blocks), and the Patch-mode patch and rhythm set, from the temporary (edit-buffer) area of the MIDI Implementation in the owner's manual.

sources.title: SonicCell MIDI Implementation (version 1.00, 2007.6.15)
sources.notes: Parameter Address Map read by tools/profiles/roland/parse-address-map.mjs from SonicCell_OM.pdf (sha256 0b49e50eca90127d8123abcbb0a54f90ac35e0a1827dbc3429a20087a2c2b869). Model ID 00 00 25, DT1 = 12, RQ1 = 11, Roland checksum. Not yet checked against the instrument itself.

authoringNotes: Generated by tools/profiles/roland/make-profiles.mjs; edit the layout in tools/profiles/roland/synths/, not this file.
Every parameter is the manual's, at the manual's address, with the manual's name. Nothing here has been sent to a real instrument yet.

The Patch-mode part's patch is at 1F 00 00 00 and its rhythm set at 1F 10 00 00, the key blocks from 1F 10 10 00 (key 21) 00 02 00 apart. Rhythm set keys 27 (D#1) to 88 (E6) are laid out, every key a General MIDI 2 drum set uses: 62 of the 88. Keys 21-26 (1F 10 10 00 to 1F 10 1A 00) and 89-108 (1F 11 18 00 to 1F 11 3E 00) are not, to keep the profile under 12,000 parameters; each is one more Rhythm Tone block of 148 parameters.

Not laid out: the sixteen Performance Mode parts' own patches and rhythm sets, at 11 00 00 00, 11 20 00 00, … 14 60 00 00 (part n at 11 00 00 00 + (n-1) × 00 20 00 00, a patch at +00 00 00 and a rhythm set at +10 00 00). Each is the Patch-mode blocks again.

Identity (p256): F0 7E dev 06 02 41 25 02 00 00 00 00 00 00 F7, family code 25 02 and family number 00 00. The JUNO-STAGE answers to the same model ID (00 00 25) and family code, with family number 00 01 (its manual p225); the number tells the two apart.

Presets list the Patches and Rhythm Sets (Bank Select MSB 87 and 86), recalled on the profile's channel, which is the Patch Receive Channel (System Common 00 0A) in Patch mode. Performances (MSB 85: User 000, Preset 064, 64 each) are selected on the Performance Control Channel and are not listed; nor are the GM2 (MSB 120/121) or SRX expansion (MSB 92/93) banks, whose sizes the manual does not print.

Performance Part (p262) prints "Part Attack Offset", "Part Release Offset" and "Part Decay Offset", and Patch Common (p263) "Attack Offset" and "Release Offset", where the JUNO-G's and JUNO-STAGE's print "… Time Offset" at the same addresses; the ids follow the manual (performance.partN.attackOffset, patch.attackOffset), so they differ from theirs.

Performance Controller (p263) is 88 bytes (Total Size 00 00 00 58) of which one parameter is printed, Recommended Tempo at 00 54; the rest is reserved, where the JUNO-G's and JUNO-STAGE's carry their D Beam, arpeggio, rhythm-pattern and chord settings.

Not read at startup (read on request, since the instrument may not answer them): patch, patch.mfx, patch.chorus, patch.reverb, patch.tmt, patch.tone1, patch.tone2, patch.tone3, patch.tone4, rhythm, rhythm.mfx, rhythm.chorus, rhythm.reverb, rhythm.key27, rhythm.key28, rhythm.key29, rhythm.key30, rhythm.key31, rhythm.key32, rhythm.key33, rhythm.key34, rhythm.key35, rhythm.key36, rhythm.key37, rhythm.key38, rhythm.key39, rhythm.key40, rhythm.key41, rhythm.key42, rhythm.key43, rhythm.key44, rhythm.key45, rhythm.key46, rhythm.key47, rhythm.key48, rhythm.key49, rhythm.key50, rhythm.key51, rhythm.key52, rhythm.key53, rhythm.key54, rhythm.key55, rhythm.key56, rhythm.key57, rhythm.key58, rhythm.key59, rhythm.key60, rhythm.key61, rhythm.key62, rhythm.key63, rhythm.key64, rhythm.key65, rhythm.key66, rhythm.key67, rhythm.key68, rhythm.key69, rhythm.key70, rhythm.key71, rhythm.key72, rhythm.key73, rhythm.key74, rhythm.key75, rhythm.key76, rhythm.key77, rhythm.key78, rhythm.key79, rhythm.key80, rhythm.key81, rhythm.key82, rhythm.key83, rhythm.key84, rhythm.key85, rhythm.key86, rhythm.key87, rhythm.key88.

coverage.inboundControllers: not modelled: what is received as CC is not mapped yet
coverage.effectParameterMeanings: type-dependent: MFX, chorus, reverb and input-effect parameters are Roland's 4-nibble container (12768-52768, shown -20000..+20000); what each slot does depends on the selected type, which the MIDI Implementation does not list
coverage.rhythmKeys: partial: keys 27-88 of the Patch-mode rhythm set (62 of 88); 21-26 (1F 10 10 00 to 1F 10 1A 00) and 89-108 (1F 11 18 00 to 1F 11 3E 00) are not laid out
coverage.performancePartTones: not modelled: the patches and rhythm sets of the 16 Performance Mode parts (11 00 00 00 to 14 60 00 00, step 00 20 00 00)
coverage.notModelled: the user memories (User Performance 20 00 00 00, User Patch 30 00 00 00, User Rhythm Set 40 00 00 00 and on)
